content_sections.heading: OPSC Lecturer in Govt. College of Physical Education Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) from any recognized University with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade and a consistently good academic record, OR Ph.D, D.Litt, M.Phil. & M.Litt with at least 50% marks in the Master's Degree. Candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes shall possess a Master's Degree in Physical Education from a recognized University with at least 50% marks or its equivalent grade. Must be able to speak, read and write Odia and must have passed M.E. School Examination with Oriya as language subject; OR have passed High School Certificate or equivalent Examination with Oriya as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR have passed Odia Language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR have passed a test in Oriya in M.E. standard conducted by the Department of School & Mass Education/Board of Secondary Education, Odisha.
